name: Snowed in with Sophie
source:
Light's been snowed in with her sister Sophie, though its cold outside, its about to get hot in here. Will the tensions between them dissolve their relationship, or build to something far more intimate?

[From [url=https://thecrimsondm-vanillia.itch.io/snowed-in-with-sophie-not-incest-edition]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
莱特和索菲姐妹俩被大雪困在了屋里。外面寒气逼人，屋里的气氛却正要升温。两人之间越绷越紧的那根弦，究竟会令关系断裂，还是把她们拉得更加亲密？

〔摘自[url=https://thecrimsondm-vanillia.itch.io/snowed-in-with-sophie-not-incest-edition]itch.io[/url]〕
